phases.name: PH1
phases.description: CSA Phase 1 – initial construction of structural steel frames, secondary steelwork, decks and steel-supported infrastructure across FSA, DCH, EYD, MYD and SSA areas.
activities: Fabrication and erection of primary structural steel frames to EXC2, grade S355 for FSA and DCH superstructures.
Installation of steel roof decking (TATA D60x1.2mm and Kingspan/Euroclad systems) over primary steel structures.
Installation of secondary steelwork to support cladding and envelope systems.
Supply and installation of miscellaneous steel items such as internal/external stairs, cat ladders, crash protection, bollards, hop-over steps and steel railings.
Provision and installation of holding down bolt assemblies and other H.D.A. items for structural frames and gantries.
Application of intumescent fire protection to structural steel members (typically 2-hour for FSA, 1-hour for DCH where noted).
Application of corrosion protection paint systems and galvanizing to external and exposed structural and secondary steel (e.g., gantries, cooling tower structures, trench steel).
Erection of structural steel for Cooling Tower Gantry including main frames, access stairs, cat ladders, railings and open mesh grating walkways.
Erection of structural steel for Generator and USS trenches including trench beams and supports for equipment.
Installation of steel supports for RMUs and battery boxes spanning trenches.
Installation of steel roof railings and access cat ladders on SSA/Load Bank Garage roof.
Steelwork penetrations and supports associated with canopies, cat ladders and similar items in the envelope scope.
Supply of hold-down bolt assemblies for multiple equipment foundations (MCP, USS, CTB, ASB, MWT, S24, S25, USS trestles, etc.).
Grouting of steel baseplates and holding down assemblies where specified as part of steel scope interface.
Provision of safety fabrications and supports for assembled roof stairs.
dependencies: Concrete foundations, plinths and slabs completed and surveyed including cast-in holding down assemblies and chemical anchors.
Waterproofing and radon barriers to foundations installed where required before steel baseplate installation.
Earthing mat installation and associated dowels completed where affecting baseplate locations.
Formwork removal and surface finishes to concrete pads acceptable for baseplate bearing and grouting.
Cladding and roofing installation sequenced after primary structural steel and main decks are erected.
Access routes, site development pavings and temporary protection in place to allow crane access and steel delivery (e.g., MYD/EYD yards, loading bays).
constraints: All structural steel to be fabricated to Execution Class 2 (EXC2) and steel grade S355, erected in accordance with NSSSBC 5th Edition where referenced.
Intumescent coatings to meet specified fire resistance periods (e.g., 2-hour for FSA, 1-hour for DCH where noted) and be compatible with corrosion protection systems.
External and exposed steelwork (gantries, stairs, railings, trench structures) to be shot-blast and hot-dip galvanized to EN ISO 1461.
Holding down bolt assemblies supplied by steelwork package but cast into concrete by CSA/civils; coordination of templates, positions and surveys required.
Steelwork erection to follow phasing of foundations across MYD, EYD, FSA, DCH and SSA to maintain access and temporary stability.
Interfaces with envelope (cladding, canopies, parapet cappings, louvres) require correctly positioned secondary steel and penetrations.
Temporary protection to cladding and roofs required during ongoing structural steel and MEP works to avoid damage at interfaces.
Security and RSA-related fencing and steel bollards to be sequenced with site development but coordinated with underground utilities.

phases.name: PH2
phases.description: CSA Phase 2 – continuation and expansion of DCH and MYD structures including additional structural steel, decks, cooling tower gantries and associated secondary steel.
activities: Fabrication and erection of additional DCH structural steel frames and extensions to Execution Class 2, steel grade S355.
Installation of further steel roof decking over new DCH structural steel areas.
Application of 1-hour intumescent fire protection to new DCH structural steelwork.
Provision and installation of holding down bolt assemblies for DCH structural steel, cooling tower gantry and associated equipment.
Erection of Phase 2 Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel including main steelwork, cat ladders, railings, stairs and open mesh grating walkways.
Installation of galvanized structural steel for RMU and battery box supports spanning trenches (Phase 2 MYD densified area).
Supply and installation of additional secondary steel to support cladding for DCH Envelope Phase 2.
Installation of miscellaneous external steelwork/metalwork such as cat ladders, bollards and small parapet stairs specific to Phase 2.
Installation of steps and ramps including handrails associated with MCP and USS platforms and access routes.
Provision of safety fabrications (supports) for assembled stairs at roof level where related to Phase 2 works.
dependencies: Completion and survey of Phase 2 DCH foundation and floor slab works including holding down assemblies and associated concrete encasements.
Completion of Phase 2 Cooling Tower Gantry pad foundations, ground beams and plinths before gantry steel erection.
USS and MCP foundations including H.D.A. cast-in and powerfloated slabs ready for steel baseplates.
Phase 2 radon membranes, waterproofing and earthing mats fully installed where underlying steel frames.
Coordination with Phase 1 structural steel and envelope to maintain structural continuity and avoid clashes at interfaces.
constraints: All Phase 2 structural steel to be fabricated to Execution Class 2 (EXC2) with grade S355 and erected per NSSSBC 5th Edition.
Cooling Tower Gantry steel to be shot-blast and hot-dip galvanized to EN ISO 1461; surface touch-up required after erection.
Secondary steel for envelope to be provided to suit Eurobond/Kingspan cladding system geometries.
Phase 2 DCH intumescent coating specified as 1-hour fire rating; coating build-up and compatibility with primers and galvanizing to be controlled.
Hold-down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 to be supplied under steelwork package; cast-in works by civils must match steel templates.
Access and lifting operations for gantry steel constrained by previously completed MYD slabs and utilities.
Temporary door and cladding protections must be in place where erection passes adjacent to completed envelope.

phases.name: PH3
phases.description: CSA Phase 3 – further build-out of site including additional DCH structures, MYD yards, cooling tower gantries and structural steel extensions, with repeated envelope and access steelwork.
activities: Fabrication and erection of additional DCH Phase 3 structural steel frames to EXC2 and S355, including extensions and infills.
Installation of additional TATA D60 roof decking and composite roof systems over Phase 3 structural steel.
Application of 1-hour intumescent fire protection to DCH Phase 3 structural steel.
Provision and installation of holding down bolt assemblies for Phase 3 DCH steel and cooling tower gantry extensions.
Erection of further Cooling Tower Gantry steelwork for Phase 3 including stairs, cat ladders, bumper railings in front of chillers, railings and open mesh grating deck.
Installation of steel supports for RMUs and battery boxes across Phase 3 trenches.
Installation of additional secondary steel for DCH envelope Phase 3, supporting Eurobond cladding and ancillary components.
Installation of further external miscellaneous steel (e.g., bollards, external stairs, safety fabrications, removable panels) tied to Phase 3 works.
Supply of steps and ramps including handrails associated with MCP and USS access (Phase 3).
dependencies: Completion of Phase 3 foundations, ground beams and slabs (DCH, MYD, EYD) with associated holding down assemblies cast-in.
Cooling Tower Gantry Phase 3 pad foundations and ground beams completed before steel erection.
Phase 3 radon and waterproofing systems including earthing mats finished prior to baseplate installation.
Envelope cladding and roofing previous phases in adjacent zones largely complete to allow safe tie-in of Phase 3 secondary steel.
Coordination with mechanical plant installation sequences on cooling towers, MCP and USS to align with steel platform availability.
constraints: All Phase 3 structural steel to conform to Execution Class 2, grade S355; galvanizing and intumescent specifications consistent with previous phases.
Cooling Tower Gantry and associated access steel to be shot-blast and galvanized per EN ISO 1461 with field touch-up.
Bumper railings and open mesh grating to meet access and safety standards for maintenance and operation around chillers.
Hold-down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 to be supplied under steelwork in correct quantities for Phase 3.
Roof penetrations, lightning protection and roof walkway systems to be coordinated with underlying decking and primary steel lines.
Temporary protection to roofs and cladding must be in place when Phase 3 steel erection proceeds near finished envelope.
Safety fabrications on roof (supports for assembled stairs) to be installed prior to or together with permanent stair steel where noted.

phases.name: PH4
phases.description: CSA Phase 4 – final DCH and MYD structural steel and gantry build-out, including remaining structural steel frames, cooling tower gantries, secondary steel and access steelwork.
activities: Fabrication and erection of DCH Phase 4 structural steel frames to EXC2 and S355, completing the structural frame sequence.
Installation of final TATA D60 roof decking areas on DCH Phase 4 steel.
Application of 1-hour intumescent fire protection to remaining DCH structural steel (Phase 4).
Provision and installation of holding down bolt assemblies for Phase 4 structural steel.
Erection of Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel for Phase 4 including main frames, cat ladders, stairs, railings and open mesh grating decks.
Supply and galvanizing of Phase 4 Cooling Tower Gantry steel, including surface touchup after erection.
Installation of secondary steel for DCH envelope Phase 4 to support cladding and roof parapets.
Installation of additional access steel (cat ladders, cooling tower stairs, steps and ramps with handrails) and associated safety railings.
Supply of hold-down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 for Phase 4 foundations.
dependencies: Completion of DCH Phase 4 foundations and floor slabs including cast-in holding down assemblies.
Completion of Cooling Tower Gantry Pad Foundations Phase 4 before erecting gantry steel.
Completion of MCP and USS Foundations Phase 4 with H.D.A. cast in and slabs finished.
Radon, waterproofing and earthing mat works completed in Phase 4 zones prior to steel baseplate installation.
Integration and tie-in of Phase 4 steelwork with prior phases of structural steel, envelope and roof systems.
constraints: All Phase 4 structural steel and gantry steel to meet EXC2, grade S355 and be erected per NSSSBC 5th Edition.
Cooling Tower Gantry and other external structural steel to be shot-blast and galvanized to EN ISO 1461; partial field touch-up required after erection.
Secondary steel for envelope must be coordinated with Eurobond/Kingspan cladding layouts and movement joints.
Hold-down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 to be delivered in correct phase-specific quantities.
Roof systems (deck, parapet upstands, lightning protection) to be coordinated with remaining steel deck and parapet steel supports.
Sequence of Phase 4 works constrained by completion of internal slabs and envelope such that heavy lifting does not compromise completed finishes.

zones.name: FSA
zones.description: Facility Services Area – includes foundations, structural steel frame, steel decking, envelope and roof for plant and service areas.
activities: FSA Structural Steel frame fabrication and erection (primary steel to EXC2, S355).
Supply and installation of FSA roof steel decking (TATA D60 and Euroclad/Kingspan systems).
Installation of FSA internal and external structural steel stairs and access steel.
Installation of holding down bolt assemblies for FSA structure and related plant supports.
Application of 2-hour intumescent fire protection to FSA structural steel.
Provision of secondary steel for FSA envelope and roof parapets.
Installation of FSA cooling/plant structural interfaces where noted (e.g., FSA Cooling Tower Stairs for MYD gantry access in some entries).
zones.logistics: Requires crane access from MYD/EYD yards and clear foundations (S02-A1500, S02-A1300 areas) before steel erection.

zones.name: DCH
zones.description: Data Center Hall – primary building housing IT halls with multi-phase foundations, structural steel frames, decks and envelope.
activities: Erection of DCH primary structural steel frames in four phases to EXC2, S355.
Installation of TATA D60 steel roof decking per phase.
Application of intumescent fire protection (1-hour in Phases 2–4; similar specification extended where listed).
Provision and installation of holding down bolt assemblies for DCH steel frames, including chemical anchors where specified.
Installation of miscellaneous steel items such as external stairs to roof, parapet stairs and bollards across phases.
Installation of secondary steel for DCH envelope in each phase to support Eurobond cladding, parapet cappings and louvres.
Coordination of structural steel with radon membranes, waterproofing systems, earthing mat and rebar design in multiple phases.
zones.logistics: Works sequenced by floor slab and foundation phases (S02-A1600 and S02-A1200 groupings) with steel phases following in order PH1 through PH4; heavy lifts coordinate with roof and envelope completion.

zones.name: EYD
zones.description: External Yard – extensive foundation slab and plinth area supporting steel columns and yard structures.
activities: Foundation slabs for EYD with embedded steel column kickers/bolts (Sec. Steel items).
USS 150mm plinths with steel column kickers/bolts in EYD.
Allocation of yard slab areas to support structural steel from MYD and cooling tower gantries via foundations.
Phase 3 repeat foundation slabs and steel column kickers for additional structures.
zones.logistics: Large foundation slab footprint (S02-A1000) to be completed in advance of superstructure steel; coordination with generator trench structural steel and utility trenches toward edge of EYD.

zones.name: MYD
zones.description: Main Yard / Mechanical Yard – densified areas with structural steel gantries, supports and multiple equipment foundations.
activities: MYD Concrete Yard slabs (Phase 1) providing bases for structural steel gantries and equipment.
Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel across phases with large tonnage, galvanized finish and extensive access stairs, railings and grating.
Generator and USS trench structural steel including beams supporting equipment across trenches.
Structural steel supports for RMUs and battery boxes spanning trenches in multiple phases.
Steel steps and ramps including handrails providing access to MCP, USS and cooling tower platforms.
zones.logistics: Yard slabs and trench structures must be in place to receive gantry and support steel; heavy cranes operate from MYD during gantry erection, constrained by trench layouts and adjacent structures.

zones.name: Cooling Tower Gantry
zones.description: Elevated structural steel gantry system supporting cooling towers and associated equipment in MYD area.
activities: Fabrication and erection of main gantry steel frames for cooling towers with galvanized finish.
Provision and installation of H.D.A. (holding down assemblies) for gantry columns.
Installation of access steel – cat ladders, emergency stairs, cooling tower stairs, railings and bumper railings in front of chillers.
Installation of open mesh grating walkways for maintenance access.
Touch-up of galvanized and painted surfaces after erection.
Interface with pad foundations, ground beams and plinths for gantry support in multiple phases.
zones.logistics: Requires sequential completion of dedicated pad foundations (S02-A1100) per phase; crane access from MYD with coordination of lifts around cooling plant equipment.

zones.name: Generator Trench Structural Steel
zones.description: Local steelwork within trench area serving generators, including protective coatings and fixings.
activities: Fabrication and installation of structural steel for generator trench.
Application of corrosion protection paint systems suitable for C2 environment.
Application of 60-minute intumescent fire protection in factory.
Touch-up painting after erection prior to handover.
Supply of holding down bolts (supply only) for trench steel interfaces.
zones.logistics: Installed after trench concrete works and before overlying yard slabs; coordination with mechanical generator installations.

zones.name: USS Trench Structural Steel
zones.description: Structural steel within Universal Sub-Station trench system including coatings and anchors.
activities: Fabrication and installation of trench structural steel for USS.
Application of corrosion protection paint suited to C2 environment and 60-minute factory-applied intumescent coating.
Touch-up after erection.
Supply of holding down bolts for USS trench and associated foundations.
zones.logistics: Coordinated with USS foundations and slabs; interfaces with MCC/USS structural steel and equipment.

zones.name: Universal Sub-Station (USS)
zones.description: Pre-engineered or modular electrical substation with dedicated foundations and access steel.
activities: Construction of USS foundations and plinths with cast-in holding down assemblies for superstructures installed by others.
Supply and installation of holding down bolt assemblies specific to USS modules.
Installation of access steps and ramps including handrails for USS platforms.
Provision of railings and related secondary steel where included under gantry or MYD scopes.
Integration of steel column kickers/bolts in EYD/USS plinths.
zones.logistics: Foundation and trench steelworks must precede delivery and installation of modular USS units; steps and ramps installed to provide safe access once modules are placed.

zones.name: Modular Cooling Plant (MCP)
zones.description: Modular cooling plant structures with dedicated foundations and structural steel access systems.
activities: Construction of MCP foundations and slabs with cast-in H.D.A. for modular plant units.
Supply of hold-down bolt assemblies for MCP structural interfaces.
Installation of steps and ramps with handrails for access to modular cooling plant platforms.
Integration with Cooling Tower Gantry steel and MYD yard structures.
zones.logistics: Requires coordinated delivery of hold-down bolts and access steel with plant supplier schedule; foundations must be complete in each phase before setting modular units.

zones.name: SSA – Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building
zones.description: Small structural steel building (Shell A) with own foundations, cladding and access steel forming part of SSA scope.
activities: Fabrication and erection of Shell A structural steel frame for Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building.
Supply and installation of holding down assemblies for SSA frame.
Shotblasting and galvanizing of SSA structural steel with touch-up after erection.
Installation of single-span roof deck (Kingspan RD 100/825) over SSA structural steel.
Installation of roof railings and a cat ladder for SSA roof access.
Provision of cladding system (Euroclad Rockspan panels) and parapet capping, including louvres and rolling shutter where noted.
Construction of SSA foundations under CSA scope to support structural steel frame and coordinate with CRC-coated slabs.
zones.logistics: SSA foundations (S02-A1000) must be completed with H.D.A. cast-in before structural steel erection; envelope and roof to follow primary steel; access from adjacent yards.

zones.name: Site Development
zones.description: General external works including fencing, bollards and auxiliary items with steel components.
activities: Installation of steel bollards in car parks and around facilities.
Installation of security chainlink fences on metal posts (RSA Security Fence).
Construction of cycle routes and external pavements indirectly affecting access for steel erection.
Provision of non-secure permanent fencing around waste storage with gates.
Provision of miscellaneous holding down assemblies and grout-in base plates for superstructures installed by others (trestles, modular buildings, walkways/platforms, generators).
zones.logistics: Must be coordinated to maintain crane and delivery access to building perimeters and MYD/EYD yards during steel erection phases.

zones.name: Underground Water & Drainage Utilities
zones.description: CSA package S01-A0303 for underground utilities – structurally relevant mainly in relation to heavy gully covers and trench interfaces near structural yards.
activities: Provision of road gullies with heavy duty cast iron covers and frames adjacent to MYD/EYD areas.
Provision of pipe accessories interfacing with structural yards and pavings.
French drains to perimeter of DCH affecting foundation drainage and steel base environment.
zones.logistics: Utilities works to be sequenced before hardstandings that support cranes and around DCH/MYD foundations to ensure proper drainage around steel bases.

steel_scope_highlights: Primary structural steel frames for FSA, DCH and SSA buildings to EXC2 with S355 material, including substantial tonnages per phase.
Extensive steel roof decking (TATA D60 and Kingspan/Euroclad systems) across all main buildings and phases.
Cooling Tower Gantry steelwork across four phases with large galvanized structural frames, access stairs, cat ladders, railings and grating.
Trench steelwork (Generator and USS) with corrosion and fire protection coatings.
Significant secondary steel for cladding and parapet systems in DCH and FSA envelopes per phase.
Intumescent fire protection systems with 2-hour (FSA) and 1-hour (DCH) ratings applied to large portions of structural steel.
Supply and coordination of holding down bolt assemblies and H.D.A. items spanning many foundations and plant structures.
Miscellaneous steel fabrications including internal and external stairs, hop-over steps, crash protection frames, bollards, railings and safety fabrications.
summary.concrete_scope_status: All concrete-related items (mixes, volumes, blinding, formwork, reinforcement quantities) were scanned only to derive interfaces and sequencing; no concrete quantities or specification details are retained in this structure.
summary.exclusions_note: Architectural finishes, MEP systems and non-structural items without direct steel interface have been omitted, except where necessary to clarify interfaces (e.g., cladding relying on secondary steel, doors in roller shutters forming part of steel-supported openings).
